task.description:
Re-review src/api/routes/agent_sandboxes.zig on branch feature/WF02-sbx04-06-20260819 after the V-01 fix (commit 92edea9c).

Verify that V-01 is resolved:
- handleClaimSandbox now performs a tenant-scoped SELECT on task_specs before binding the claim
- The query uses parameterised placeholders ($1) for task_spec_id
- 0 rows → HTTP 404 task_spec_not_found is returned

Re-check all invariants from the prior review:
- INV-1 tenant isolation: all queries include tenant_id predicate
- INV-2 field authorisation: V-01 fix applied
- INV-4 no secrets
- INV-5 probe indistinguishability (SBX-05 sentinel)
- INV-7 SQL parameterisation
- INV-8 no catch unreachable on realistic failures

Run: git diff origin/main...feature/WF02-sbx04-06-20260819 -- src/ migrations/

Return PASS or FAIL with specific remaining violations.

result.summary: V-01 is resolved. handleClaimSandbox now performs a tenant-scoped SELECT on task_specs (parameterised $1::uuid, tenant predicate via current_setting) before the claim UPDATE; 0 rows returns 404 task_spec_not_found. All six invariants re-checked against the full diff (agent_sandboxes.zig, sandbox_access.zig, sandbox_pool.zig, migration 1172). No remaining violations.

issues.description: reclaimIdleSandboxes passes empty string for tenant_id to writeAuditInTx. The audit row lands in the correct tenant schema (conn2 search_path is set), but the audit payload JSON will have tenant_id: '' rather than the actual tenant UUID. Data quality defect only; no security isolation impact.

invariant_assessments.INV-1: PASS — migration 1172 has scope: tenant_only; all queries rely on search_path isolation; sandbox_probe_counters table is created within the tenant schema.
invariant_assessments.INV-2: PASS — V-01 fix applied: task_spec_id validated against task_specs with tenant predicate before claim. Success responses return minimal payloads ({} or 204 empty); sentinel bodies contain no tenant business data beyond the caller-supplied sandbox_id.
invariant_assessments.INV-4: PASS — no secret material in any response, audit payload, or new struct field. Audit payloads contain principal, sandbox_id, task_spec_id, rejection_code, tenant_id only.
invariant_assessments.INV-5: PASS — both cross-tenant and nonexistent sandbox cases in handleClaimSandbox (0 rows from UPDATE) and handleReleaseSandbox (checkPrincipalBound inaccessible) return identical 403 sandbox_not_accessible with identical body shape. Probe rate limiting applied to both.
invariant_assessments.INV-7: PASS — all SQL in new code uses $1/$2/... parameterised placeholders. std.fmt.allocPrint is used only for response/audit JSON construction and formatting a u64 number as a parameter value, never to build SQL text.
invariant_assessments.INV-8: PASS — no catch unreachable in any new code path. All error paths use catch return, catch {}, catch null, catch continue, or fallback values.
